print kit

Flyer, story and cards. Everything is real HTML at true print dimensions — ⌘P and each piece lands on its own page at size.

In the print dialog: tick Print backgrounds (Safari hides it under the collapsed “Safari” section at the bottom; Chrome calls it “Background graphics” under More settings). Untick Print headers and footers or every flyer gets a URL and a page number on it. Margins: None.

The QR points at vveritascoaching.com/dmv and is vector, so it stays sharp at any size. Scan it before you print a hundred.
